commands.command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
python3 - <<'PY'
import re
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('apps/mobile/src')
counts={'button':0,'input':0,'select':0,'textarea':0}
matching_files=set()
for p in root.rglob('*.tsx'):
 if p.name.endswith(('.test.tsx','.spec.tsx')):continue
 s=p.read_text()
 for tag in counts:
  n=len(re.findall(r'<'+tag+r'(?=[\s/>])',s))
  counts[tag]+=n
  if n:matching_files.add(p)
print('PRODUCTION_NATIVE_CENSUS',counts,'FILES',len(matching_files))
assert counts=={'button':56,'input':10,'select':0,'textarea':0}
assert len(matching_files)==31
p=Path('docs/testing/2026-10-10-ionic-native-control-census.md')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('1a6021e8a246667005dadbe4d72e335fbaee5b4d','d4485ad76fdcf9b03d39270344e6df2561b86f81')
s=s.replace('**67 = 57 przycisków + 10 input**','**66 = 56 przycisków + 10 input**')
s=s.replace('23 zwykłych przycisków','22 zwykłe przyciski')
s=s.replace('wszystkich 23 zwykłych przycisków','wszystkich 22 zwykłych przycisków')
lines=[]
for line in s.splitlines():
 if line.startswith('|') and 'screens/hardware-setup/pages/ShellySetupPresentation.tsx' in line:
  cols=line.split('|')
  cols[2]=' 3 '
  cols[3]=' 3 celowe '
  cols[4]=' Ikonowe edytuj/ustawienia/usuń pozostają; skan BLE na zapisanej karcie używa IonButton '
  line='|'.join(cols)
 lines.append(line)
s='\n'.join(lines).rstrip()+'\n'
s+='\n## Saved Shelly BLE card — accepted 2026-10-11\n\n'
s+='Commit d4485ad76fdcf9b03d39270344e6df2561b86f81 migrated the compact saved-card BLE scan button to IonButton, retaining callback, busy-disabled semantics and card styling. The 58 hardware setup tests passed, as did a canonical phone-large BLE E2E with screenshot 04-plug-ble-discovery. Entire 50-case visual E2E passed without snapshot changes. Full pnpm check passed 554/554 mobile tests, Capacitor sync and Android debug assembly passed. Total remaining 66 native JSX controls (56 button, 10 frozen Climate inputs), with 22 ordinary actions and 34 intentional custom controls. No phone or physical Shelly device was contacted.\n'
p.write_text(s)
note='\n## Accepted saved Shelly BLE card Ionic slice — 2026-10-11\n\n'
note+='Product commit: d4485ad76fdcf9b03d39270344e6df2561b86f81. The saved Shelly card BLE scan is now an IonButton with unchanged onBleScan(device) and busy disabled state. CSS preserves a compact no-padding clear action. The source census is **66 native JSX controls = 56 buttons + 10 protected Climate inputs**, 31 files. Of those, 22 ordinary actions remain and 34 custom controls remain intentionally native. See docs/testing/2026-10-10-ionic-native-control-census.md.\n\n'
note+='Verified directly on this product source: 58/58 hardware setup tests, 1/1 phone-large BLE visual scenario, 50/50 canonical responsive/visual E2E with no snapshots updated, **pnpm check PASS** including 554/554 mobile tests, and Capacitor Android sync plus Gradle debug build. APK SHA-256: 75b95492e8ca748c0b5e004865ccbb08f4b32c383a77c6c93bd2db6aa6020d96; size 5,179,520 B. Source tree clean.\n\n'
note+='Hard performance budget remains within bounds, but review thresholds still fail: JS 2,370,359 B (largest 1,043,584 B), CSS 154,382 B, 20 JS chunks. The headless medium_phone emulator did not finish boot on the previous attempt; real Android TalkBack/keyboard/overlay verification and intermittent lifecycle triggerEvent investigation remain open. Phone and relays untouched; main unchanged.\n'
for path in ('docs/testing/2026-10-10-ionic-independent-audit.md','docs/CHECKPOINT_2026-10-08_UX_EVOLUTION.md','docs/HANDOFF_NEXT_CHAT.md'):
 p=Path(path);body=p.read_text()
 assert '## Accepted saved Shelly BLE card Ionic slice — 2026-10-11' not in body
 p.write_text(body.rstrip()+'\n'+note)
PY
pnpm exec prettier --write docs/testing/2026-10-10-ionic-native-control-census.md docs/testing/2026-10-10-ionic-independent-audit.md docs/CHECKPOINT_2026-10-08_UX_EVOLUTION.md docs/HANDOFF_NEXT_CHAT.md
pnpm exec prettier --check docs/testing/2026-10-10-ionic-native-control-census.md docs/testing/2026-10-10-ionic-independent-audit.md docs/CHECKPOINT_2026-10-08_UX_EVOLUTION.md docs/HANDOFF_NEXT_CHAT.md
git diff --check
git add docs/testing/2026-10-10-ionic-native-control-census.md docs/testing/2026-10-10-ionic-independent-audit.md docs/CHECKPOINT_2026-10-08_UX_EVOLUTION.md docs/HANDOFF_NEXT_CHAT.md
git commit -m "docs(ionic): record full BLE card acceptance and 66 native controls"
git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/work/ux-evolution
echo "DOCS_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
git status --short
